PART – I: INSTRUCTION FOR SUBMISSION OF TENDER: - Tenderers should go through the details given below carefully before submitting the offers. OVERVIEW OF PROCUREMENT: Durgapur Steel Plant (DSP) invites bids for supply of 2 nos. Converter grade power transformers. A. Special Terms & Condition: 1. Offers with make empanelled in CET approved make list dated Feb’26 (sl.7.3) will be considered for evaluation. Offers with make other than approved makes mentioned above will not be considered for evaluation and shall be rejected. In case of submission of offer by the Authorized Dealer / Channel Partner / System House of OEMs, suc h offer(s) will only be considered with valid authorized dealership/partnership certificate issued by the OEM(s) and such OEM(s) should be anyone of the acceptable makes mentioned above. 2. Party has to submit technical literature, type test report of similar type transformer along with the bid.

3. Within 30 days of PO, the vendor has to submit GA diagram, QAP and technical details to DSP. Manuf acturing clearance will be given after approval of GA and technical details of the transformer by the in denting department. 4. Certificate of routine factory tests as per IS 2026 (aligned with dry type converter grade power trans formers.) are to be supplied and get it approved by DSP for dispatch clearance. 5. Inspection will be carried out jointly with CSD at DSP premises with the approved GA and test report s. 6. GC must be submitted at the time of delivery. 7. Technical support has to be provided at the time of commissioning. 8. Payment term- 95% of total value after GRN and 5% after successful commissioning of the transform ers. 9. These transformers will be installed indoor at the location of existing transformers which are of ONA N type. GA dimension of the new dry type transformers shall be subject to existing space and the vend or may do site visit to confirm. 10. Dimension of existing transformer room-5800 width*4300 depth*4000 height Dimension of existing transformer room gate- 3000 width*3500 height (Dimensions are in mm.) B. Other terms and conditions: i. Price shall remain firm till completion of supply to DSP. ii. Any deviation to the specification/terms and conditions is to clearly state in a separate sheet (FORM T-1) by wr iting “DEVIATION” in bold letters at the top of the page and soft copy of the deviation is to submitted along wit h the offer. It may further please be noted that Durgapur Steel Plant reserves the right to reject any “OFFER W ITH DEVIATION” without any further correspondence. iii. Tenderer should submit filled Undertaking including Bid Securing Declaration(Annexure-I attached) and Annex ure- A (i). iv. Tenderer should submit No barring/pending complaint declaration (Annexure-II attached) v. Price to be quoted in GeM portal under price template as per GeM conditions. vi. After generation of the GeM Contract, an SAP backup order will be generated in favour of the successful bidde r to facilitate smooth supply, payment, etc. However, all the terms and conditions shall remain governed by th e GeM Contract and the terms agreed upon during the GeM tendering process. vii. Delivery: FOR DSP (Durgapur Steel Plant) For the payment: Original (4 hard copies) of invoice duly signed and stamped along with GRN no. therein, is t o be submitted to the following address for release of payment. If any of the bidders is under suspension / banning and / or have pending complaints at Durgapur Steel Plant / other SAIL units, offer of such bidders will be outright rejected.
